newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE Feb 3.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Alcatel Alsthom to ally with Aerospatiale and Dassault to bid for defence electronics group Thomson. Prime Minister Alain Juppe confirms details of Thomson's privatisation process will be known before end February.
-- Mainstream right withdraws list from town council election in southern town of Vitrolles to prevent a victory of the far-right national front party.

-- GAN chairman to present report on the insurer's accounts that includes need for a state recapitalisation estimated at between 15 and 20 billion francs. Bailout plan being worked on with government includes three parts : a sale of all real-estate assets, a privatisation of nearly all of CIC CICF.PA bank, and a sale of 30 percent of the capital to one bidder, followed by a public sale of the remaining shares.

-- Generale des Eaux and Havas confirm talks on Canal Plus, Generale des Eaux to transfer to Havas its stake in Canal Plus, making it a majority shareholder in Canal Plus. In return Generale des Eaux would take a bigger stake in Havas.
-- Carrefour supermarkets to sign supply agreement with some 500 small and medium-sized companies.
